_comment: Machine-readable handoff contract for RLinf / IsaacLab. Authoritative prose: ACTION_CONTRACT.md. Do not edit one without the other.
_status: SFT pipeline validated end-to-end; the checkpoint below is a 20-step SMOKE artifact, NOT a trained policy. Replace checkpoint_path after a real SFT run.
checkpoint_path_note: No trained checkpoint exists yet. The 20-step smoke run wrote final_model/pytorch_model.pt (4.2 GB) and it was DELETED afterwards per checkpoint-retention discipline - it had no policy value. A real SFT run writes to <run_dir>/final_model/pytorch_model.pt; set this field then.
degenerate_dims_note: q01 == q99 for these; Normalizer.forward passes them through UNNORMALIZED (raw units). Model output for these dims is already physical, not in [-1,1].
controller_expectation: downstream PD position controller tracks these targets
execution_semantics: predict 30 absolute targets (0.6 s), execute open-loop, then re-plan

navigate_command.note: vx, vy, vyaw; ALL ZERO in this dataset (stationary task)

state_unmapped_note: observation.state[29:63] is 34 tactile channels, IDENTICALLY ZERO in all 45938 frames. Excluded.
task_string: pick up the piston with the right hand, inject it into the tube held by the left hand, then move it over the hole plate.
task_string_note: VERBATIM, single task_index 0, identical across all 67 episodes. RLinf must send this byte-for-byte (lowercase 'pick', trailing period). Any rewording is out-of-distribution.

isaaclab_action_mapping._doc: See ISAACLAB_MAPPING.md for evidence per row.
isaaclab_action_mapping.simulator_action_semantics: JointPositionActionCfg(joint_names=['.*'], scale=1.0, use_default_offset=True) -> offset from default pose
isaaclab_action_mapping.conversion: action_53[art_idx] = starvla_action_30[ds_dim]; identity because every default joint position is 0.0

dropped_ds_dims.26: base_height - no articulation DOF; fixed-base task; constant 0.76 in data
dropped_ds_dims.27: nav_vx - no DOF; exactly 0.0 in all frames
dropped_ds_dims.28: nav_vy - no DOF; exactly 0.0 in all frames
dropped_ds_dims.29: nav_yaw - no DOF; exactly 0.0 in all frames

hold_at_default_inspire_intermediate_dis.status: PARTIALLY RESOLVED - 0.0 is a valid command (proven); that the original replay used 0.0 is NOT proven

is_zero_valid.finding: These are independently driven PhysicsRevoluteJoints (PhysicsDriveAPI:angular, stiffness 20.0, damping 0.01745, maxForce 50-150). An exhaustive stage scan found 0 mimic attributes and no mimic/tendon schema. They are NOT passive and NOT coupled in this asset.
is_zero_valid.resolution: Command 0.0. With use_default_offset=True and q_default=0.0 for all 24 Inspire joints, 0.0 commands exactly the default pose.

did_the_replay_use_zero.answer: NOT PROVEN - documented fidelity caveat, not a correctness blocker
did_the_replay_use_zero.counter_evidence: A 6->12 coupling expansion exists in this ecosystem: GR00T-WBC-Bridge/scripts/run_isaac_sim_loop.py calls Dex3InspireMapper.inspire6_to_urdf12() on each hand, documented as 'inspire 41 DOF, 26 upper body (7+6+7+6), URDF coupling'.
did_the_replay_use_zero.why_unresolved: replay_piston_csv.py (named as the dataset author in meta/info.json) is absent from this machine, and gr00t_wbc_bridge is an optional install.sh --with-bridge clone that was never fetched. The mapper implementation and URDF_HAND_JOINTS_* constants are therefore unavailable.
did_the_replay_use_zero.why_the_dataset_cannot_arbitrate: It records exactly 6 hand DOF per hand in both observation.state and action; the 12 URDF joints appear nowhere. get_robot_inspire_joint_states gathers only the 12 PROXIMAL indices [36,37,35,34,48,38,31,32,30,29,43,33]. Proximal joints track their own commands at corr 0.993-0.997 under either hypothesis, so the correlation carries no discriminating information.
did_the_replay_use_zero.why_the_bridge_may_not_apply: The bridge drives a whole-body 41-DOF config, not the fixed-base variant the piston task uses, and it seeds target from current joint_pos rather than writing a default-pose offset for all 53 DOFs.
did_the_replay_use_zero.to_close: Obtain inspire6_to_urdf12 from the GR00T-WBC-Bridge repo or replay_piston_csv.py and record the ratio. DO NOT reconstruct it by guessing. If coupling was used, the fix is a 12-element expansion in the deployment adapter only; the SFT checkpoint and the 30-D action space are unaffected either way.

hold_at_default_inspire_intermediate_dis.caveat: If the demonstrations were recorded with coupling, the deployed hand curls less at the middle phalanges than the demonstrator's did. A visual/contact-geometry difference confined to the fingers - not a wrong action space, units, or joint assignment. The dataset only ever commanded 6 DOF per hand, so no SFT signal exists for the other 6 regardless.
hold_at_default_inspire_intermediate_dis.note_on_config_yaml: The asset config.yaml records convert_mimic_joints_to_normal_joints:false, implying the source URDF had mimic joints. The converted USD that the sim loads has none, so that flag is not evidence of runtime coupling.
hold_at_default_inspire_intermediate_dis.corroboration: IsaacLab's own G1 Inspire task lists exactly these 24 as hand_joint_names ('All the drive and mimic joints, total 24 joints', num_hand_joints=24) and its retargeter solves all 12 per hand as independent DOFs.

inspire_joint_limits_rad.note: The dataset's left-hand constant 1.7000 rad is EXACTLY the finger upper limit (fully curled, gripping the tube), confirming the data was authored against this same hand model.

isaaclab_camera_mapping.evidence: g1_redball_eval overlay states the dataset ego_view is the D435 color stream at 424x240 and configures front_camera accordingly.

INTRINSICS_MISMATCH.impact: The piston task renders a much wider view than any training frame; the policy would receive out-of-distribution imagery.
INTRINSICS_MISMATCH.fix_location: unitree_sim_isaaclab piston scene cfg (NOT StarVLA). Not applied - outside this task's scope.

dataset_origin: IsaacLab replay of piston CSV trajectories (replay_piston_csv.py); all episodes success=true

server_protocol._note: Per the reference checkpoint README; NOT verified in this pass - no deployment run was performed.
server_protocol.known_issue_RESOLVED: PolicyNormProcessor raised 'Video key ego_view not found in dataset metadata' for data configs with video augmentation (ours has one). Reproduced against this data config, then fixed in deployment/model_server/policy_norm_processor.py (video metadata is now synthesized from data_config.video_keys + obs_image_size). Regression-tested. The reference checkpoint's policy_norm_processor_PATCHED.py drop-in is no longer needed.

unresolved: No closed-loop evaluation was performed. No policy-quality claim is made.

BLOCKING closed-loop: the piston task's front_camera renders 105.5 deg HFOV vs the dataset's 69 deg. Requires a sim-side camera cfg change in unitree_sim_isaaclab (not applied here). This is the one hard blocker for evaluation.

Fidelity caveat (not blocking): the 12 Inspire intermediate/distal DOFs are held at 0.0. Verified independently driven with no coupling in the USD, so this is the correct default, but the fingers will not curl at the middle joint.
Whether the RLinf/IsaacLab controller requires proprioceptive state input. If yes, wire StateActionDropout before enabling state.
navigate_command and base_height are constant in this dataset, so the policy gets no learning signal for locomotion or torso height. RL must not assume these are controllable from SFT.

Zero-order hold (2 env steps per action) is specified but NOT implemented: there is no action-repeat mechanism in rlinf/envs/. Must be added at IsaaclabBaseEnv.chunk_step before closed-loop evaluation.

control_rate_conversion.do_not_implement_by: emitting 60 actions from the policy or duplicating rows in the learned representation - that would redefine action_horizon and break this contract

episode_budget.verdict: episode_length_s=20.0 is SUFFICIENT; do not raise it

implementer_notes: max_episode_steps must be in ENV steps (2000), not policy actions (1000): step() increments _elapsed_steps per env step and truncates on cfg.max_episode_steps.

Workers compute n_chunk_steps = max_episode_steps // num_action_chunks (huggingface_worker.py:103, sglang_embodied_worker.py:79). With 2000 env steps and num_action_chunks=30 -> 66 chunk iterations. Keep num_action_chunks at 30; do not inflate it to 60 to fake the hold.
Accumulate reward across the 2 repeated env steps.
